concept: a bog troll one with the mire; the muddy ground never slows it, and it wades where nothing can follow
a gargoyle-thing that scuttles along the cathedral ceiling and drops from the gutters onto stragglers
a hanged judge whose noose still tightens around the guilty from a hundred feet away; it always knows exactly where its quarry stands
a drowned lighthouse keeper, bloated and waterlogged, who leaves a spreading slick of brine wherever she moves
a ridge exile of living scree whose hide crumbles into a wake of rubble that pursuers slow in
a bloodhound stitched from three dead dogs that never loses a scent once it has tasted blood
a mountain goat with antlers of living ice that butts climbers off the ledge and freezes the handholds behind them
a cellar spider the size of a hound that hangs from the rafters and knows every thread of its web
a foundry overseer welded into his own furnace-suit who brands deserters and hunts them down wherever they run
a bell-ringer's ghost who tolls the hour and cannot leave the tower
